item.b: A Punisher who lived in the sewers. The collision came from above.

item: Scott Lang, VistaCorp burglar, set for release from San Quentin

item.where: The capital city of Xandar, home of the Nova Empire
item.cause: Ronan the Accuser, who rejects the Kree Empire's peace treaty with Xandar, sets the Orb's Power Stone in his warhammer, betrays Thanos, and flies the Dark Aster to Xandar to wipe out the planet.
item.out: The Nova Corps' pilots lock their ships into a barrier around the Dark Aster, but Ronan breaks through with the stone, and the Guardians and Yondu's Ravagers storm the ship while the city is evacuated. Rocket crashes a ship through the Dark Aster's bridge and it falls onto the city, then the Guardians share the stone's power between them and destroy Ronan.
loss: Garthan Saal, killed when Ronan breaks the Nova blockade.
Groot, who wraps his friends in his branches as the Dark Aster crashes.
Korath, killed by Drax aboard the Dark Aster.
Ronan, destroyed by the Power Stone.
fall: The Nova Corps lock the Orb away on Xandar, clear the Guardians' records and rebuild the Milano, and a cutting from Groot sprouts into a new Groot.
Guardians of the Galaxy
Yondu leaves with the Orb Peter handed him and finds a troll doll inside.
Guardians of the Galaxy
Thanos takes the Power Stone from Xandar and leaves the planet decimated.
Avengers: Infinity War

item.where: Josie's Bar, Hell's Kitchen, New York
item.cause: Vanessa Fisk has Bullseye freed from prison to kill Foggy Nelson, whose client's case was about to expose the secret of Red Hook Port.
item.out: Bullseye shoots Foggy from a rooftop as he celebrates with Matt Murdock and Karen Page, then turns on the bar. Daredevil fights him through the building and, after Foggy dies, throws him off the roof, and Bullseye survives to be arrested.
loss: Bar patrons and neighbors caught in the attack.
fall: Cherry, a police detective at the bar, learns that Matt is Daredevil.
Daredevil: Born Again S1
Matt hangs up the suit for a year, and Karen leaves New York.
Daredevil: Born Again S1
Haunted by Foggy's death, Bullseye sets out to kill the Fisks to balance the scales.
Daredevil: Born Again S2

item.b: In this reality, a plague from the Quantum Realm turned Earth's heroes into the hungry dead. A handful of young survivors fight on, Kamala Khan among them. I am sworn only to watch.

item.where: The Vault, New York
item.cause: Spider-Man volunteers to test the security of the Vault, a new prison for super villains, and the Green Goblin hacks its system and releases every inmate.
item.out: Hunted by Silvermane, the Enforcers and a robot Mysterio, Spider-Man works with the Black Cat and her imprisoned father, Walter Hardy, to contain them, and the Rhino and the Molten Man are gassed and locked up again. Walter is revealed as the burglar who killed Uncle Ben, and he stays in prison.
fall: Felicia blames Spider-Man when her father stays behind bars.
The Spectacular Spider-Man
Spider-Man unmasks the Green Goblin as Norman Osborn, who fakes his death.
The Spectacular Spider-Man

item.b: Spider-Man stopped by to let us know he's leaving town on a trip. He asked us to keep an eye on the neighborhood while he's gone. We said we'd manage.

item.where: The Metropolitan Opera House, New York
item.cause: Tombstone, Doctor Octopus and Silvermane meet at the Metropolitan Opera House for a Valentine's Day summit over who will rule New York's underworld, and Hammerhead, secretly played by the Green Goblin, betrays them all to become the new Big Man.
item.out: The summit erupts into a gang war that spills out in front of the opera house. Spider-Man disables Silvermane's hydraulic armor and subdues Doctor Octopus, Hammerhead's gunfire knocks out the Vulture, and police take the bosses away.
fall: Tombstone is arrested but makes bail.
The Spectacular Spider-Man

item.where: The city center, Johannesburg, South Africa
item.cause: After Ultron's fight with the Avengers at Ulysses Klaue's salvage yard, Wanda Maximoff slips into Bruce Banner's mind with a nightmare, and the Hulk runs wild through Johannesburg.
item.out: Tony Stark calls in the Hulkbuster armor and fights the Hulk through the streets and office buildings, finally bringing a tower under construction down on top of them both. The Hulk comes out of the rubble and begins to calm down at the sight of the damage, and Tony knocks him out.
loss: Streets and buildings across the city center, and a tower under construction.
fall: The world turns against the Avengers, and the shaken team hides out at Clint Barton's farm.
Avengers: Age of Ultron
A year later, Johannesburg is still on the mend as WHIH Newsfront debates who should answer for the Avengers' damage.
WHIH Newsfront (Part 2)

Ichirō Yashida, Japan's richest man, dies

beats: To keep the Mind Stone from Thanos, Steve's team brings Vision to Wakanda, where Shuri starts taking the stone out of his head.
The Black Order brings an army of Outriders down outside the shield, and Proxima Midnight refuses to turn back.

The Outriders tear themselves apart on the shield. T'Challa has a section opened to draw them in, and Wakanda's army charges with Steve, Natasha, Bucky Barnes, Okoye and M'Baku's Jabari, while Sam Wilson and James Rhodes fight from the air.
Thor arrives with Rocket, Groot and his new axe, Stormbreaker, and cuts through the Outriders.
Wanda leaves the lab to join the fight, stops the Outriders' threshers and throws Proxima Midnight into one, as Proxima fights Natasha and Okoye.
Corvus Glaive gets into the lab and goes after Vision, who kills him with Steve's help. Bruce Banner, in the Hulkbuster, drives Cull Obsidian into the shield.
Thanos arrives through a portal and swats the heroes aside one by one.
Wanda destroys the Mind Stone as Vision dies, but Thanos turns back time with the Time Stone and tears it from his head.
Thor drives Stormbreaker into Thanos's chest, but not his head, and Thanos snaps.
Thanos escapes through a portal. Bucky, T'Challa, Groot, Wanda and Sam turn to dust.

item: Cletus Kasady escapes his own execution

key: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
item: The River Thames drains overnight
Reed Richards and Sue Storm's wedding interrupted

item.where: The S.H.I.E.L.D. carrier Iliad, at sea
item.cause: Jiaying, leader of the Inhumans of Afterlife, kills Robert Gonzales and blames S.H.I.E.L.D. to start a war, then plans to seize the carrier Iliad and spread Terrigen across the world from a Quinjet loaded with crystals.
item.out: Gordon teleports her people aboard and they take the ship, petrifying agents who will not obey her. Coulson's team retakes it: Fitz traps Gordon, who teleports onto a pipe in Fitz's hands, Mack cuts off Coulson's hand to stop the stone spreading, Skye blasts the Quinjet of crystals into the ocean, and Cal kills Jiaying to save their daughter.
loss: Gordon, impaled on the pipe in Fitz's hands.
S.H.I.E.L.D. agents turned to stone by Jiaying's crystals.
fall: Cal's memory is erased, and he starts a new life.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
The crystals dissolve into the sea and get into fish oil sold around the world, and new Inhumans begin to appear everywhere.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
Coulson, now wearing a prosthetic hand, forms the Secret Warriors with Daisy to find and protect the new Inhumans.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3

item.b: Teenage X-Men, still in high school. Nobody graduates.

item: New masked hero swings into action over New York

item.where: The Kravinoff family's animal sanctuary, Russia
item.cause: Aleksei Sytsevich kidnaps Dmitri Kravinoff to move against Nikolai's empire, then hires the assassin known as the Foreigner to kill Kraven, and the two track Kraven and Calypso to his mother's animal sanctuary.
item.out: The Foreigner drugs Kraven with a neurotoxin, but Calypso kills him with a crossbow and revives Kraven, who drives a buffalo stampede onto Aleksei. Aleksei turns into the Rhino and briefly overpowers him before Kraven kills him.
fall: Kraven learns his father set his sons against Aleksei, and lures a bear into killing Nikolai.
Kraven the Hunter
A year later, Dmitri has taken over their father's criminal empire and can change his shape.
Kraven the Hunter

item.where: The Vienna International Centre, Vienna
item.cause: A bomb goes off at the United Nations conference where the Sokovia Accords are being ratified.
item.out: Security footage points to Bucky Barnes, and T'Challa vows to kill him. The bombing is Helmut Zemo's work: he framed Bucky to draw him out.
loss: King T'Chaka of Wakanda, among others.
fall: Bucky is hunted across Europe, and the Avengers split over the Accords.
Captain America: Civil War
T'Challa takes the throne of Wakanda.
Black Panther

item.where: Xandar, in the reality where Ronan overthrew Thanos
item.cause: Ronan, having overthrown Thanos, closes in on Xandar, which has sealed itself behind a planetary shield. Nova Prime Irani Rael secretly plots to hand the planet over to him, and Yon-Rogg steals the shield codes from Nebula for Ronan.
item.out: Nebula, who saw through the plot, has changed the code so that the shield closes again as the Dark Aster passes through, destroying the ship and killing Ronan. Nova Prime falls to her death trying to flee, Korg kills Yon-Rogg, and the shield opens again.
loss: Yondu Udonta, found murdered before the siege.
Ronan, killed when the shield crushes the Dark Aster.
Nova Prime Irani Rael, who falls to her death.
fall: Nebula, now Nova Prime, defends Xandar from a giant monster and thanks Captain Carter's team for slaying it.
What If...?

item.where: New York
item.cause: Freed from a decades-old vortex by his son Rheinholt Kragov and the Chameleon, the Red Skull uses his wartime Doomsday Device on Kragov and turns him into Electro.
item.out: Electro seizes New York's power, topples S.H.I.E.L.D. and demands that the United Nations make him ruler of the world. Spider-Man and Captain America fix the vortex, Electro is sucked into it trying to prove his power, and the Red Skull is trapped with Captain America in another dimension.
loss: Captain America, lost again with the Red Skull.
fall: The Beyonder later frees the Red Skull for his Secret Wars, where he rules an empire until Spider-Man's team defeats him.
Spider-Man (1994)

item.n: The Attack on Tony Stark's Home
item.where: Tony Stark's mansion, Malibu, California
item.cause: After Tony dares the Mandarin on television, Killian sends helicopter gunships to his house in Malibu.
item.out: Missiles bring the house down. Tony puts his armor on Pepper to save her and Maya Hansen, then sinks with the wreckage into the sea, and J.A.R.V.I.S. flies him to Tennessee.
loss: Tony's Malibu home and workshop, destroyed, along with the Mark I.
fall: Believed dead, Tony is stranded in Rose Hill, where a kid named Harley helps him fix his suit.
Iron Man 3

item.b: Scott Lang is days away from finishing his house arrest. Every time we check, he's home. I'd still like to know who was out in the bay this week. And why there is an ant playing the drums in his house.

item: She-Hulk smashes up a lawyers' awards gala

item.where: A power station and a clock tower, New York
item.cause: Freed from Ravencroft by Harry Osborn, Electro takes over a power station and plunges New York into darkness, leaving two airliners on a collision course.
item.out: Spider-Man and Gwen overload Electro, who explodes, and the power comes back in time. Harry, twisted into the Green Goblin by the spider venom, arrives on a glider and carries Gwen to the top of a clock tower, and in the fight she falls to her death as Peter's web catches her too late.
loss: Max Dillon, destroyed in the overload.
Gwen Stacy, killed in the fall at the clock tower.
fall: Peter gives up being Spider-Man for five months, until Gwen's graduation speech moves him to face the Rhino.
The Amazing Spider-Man 2
Harry is locked in Ravencroft and has the Gentleman start forming a team.
The Amazing Spider-Man 2
Pulled into another universe, this Peter catches that world's MJ in a fall like Gwen's.
Spider-Man: No Way Home

beats: Thanos's warship opens fire on the Avengers Compound and flattens it. James Rhodes, Rocket, Scott Lang and the Hulk are trapped under the ruins, and Clint Barton is lost in the tunnels below with the Nano Gauntlet.
Thor, Steve and Tony face Thanos in the ruins, and Thanos overpowers Thor and Tony.
Steve lifts Mjolnir and fights Thanos on his own, until Thanos breaks his shield.
Thanos's army comes down from the warship and lines up against Steve alone.
Doctor Strange, Wong and the sorcerers open portals around the field. Wakanda's army, the Asgardians, the Ravagers and every returned hero come through.

Scott rises out of the ruins at giant size with Rhodes, Rocket and the Hulk in his hand. Hope van Dyne arrives as the Wasp, Pepper Potts lands beside Tony in her own armor, and Steve calls the Avengers to assemble.
Clint carries the gauntlet out of the tunnels and hands it to T'Challa, and it reaches Peter Parker.
The plan is to get the gauntlet into the quantum tunnel in the back of Scott's van, out of Thanos's reach. Scott needs about ten minutes to get it working.
Wanda attacks Thanos and nearly tears him apart, until he orders his warship to fire on the battlefield.
Carol Danvers arrives and destroys the warship.
Carol takes the gauntlet from Peter, and Wanda, Okoye, Valkyrie and the others clear her a path to the van.
Thanos throws his sword into the van and destroys the quantum tunnel. Carol fights him for the gauntlet, until he knocks her away with the Power Stone.
Tony looks to Doctor Strange, who is holding back a flood of water, and Strange holds up one finger: the one future of 14,000,605 where they win.
Thanos throws Tony aside and snaps, but nothing happens. Tony has taken the stones into his own armor.
Tony snaps. Thanos and his army turn to dust, and Tony dies of the stones' power, with Pepper beside him.

item: Four heroes save the Brooklyn Bridge
The press calls them the Fantastic Four

item.t: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
item.b: Kamar-Taj is rebuilding, and we have buried our dead. A new student has joined us. Her name is America Chavez, and she travels between universes. Be kind to her.

item.where: The PRIDE dig site, Los Angeles
item.cause: Jonah reveals that he is digging up the ship buried beneath Los Angeles to take his family home, and both PRIDE and the Runaways fear that its launch will bring earthquakes across California.
item.out: The Runaways slip into the dig site to free Karolina's family but fail, and PRIDE blows up the ship, while Nico stabs Jonah with the Staff of One and he falls. Unseen, Jonah's family survives and takes over members of PRIDE.
loss: Jonah's host body, killed by Nico.
Jonah's ship, blown up by PRIDE.
fall: Jonah's family, in the bodies of Victor, Stacey and Tina, captures Karolina, Chase and Janet to prolong their lives.
Runaways S1–S2
Alex is revealed to be possessed by Jonah's son, and Nico summons the Staff of One and makes Jonah's family vanish.
Runaways S3
Xavin takes Leslie's newborn daughter Elle, Jonah's child, into space.
Runaways S3

item.where: Leipzig/Halle Airport, Germany
item.cause: Steve Rogers and Bucky Barnes, wanted under the Sokovia Accords, set out to stop Helmut Zemo from waking HYDRA's other Winter Soldiers in Siberia, and Tony Stark leads a team to the airport to bring them in.
item.out: The two sides of the Avengers fight across the tarmac, and Scott Lang grows to giant size to cover Steve and Bucky's run for a Quinjet, which they reach when Natasha Romanoff stuns Black Panther to let them go. Vision fires at Sam Wilson but hits James Rhodes, who falls from the sky, and Sam, Wanda Maximoff, Clint Barton and Scott are arrested.
loss: James Rhodes, shot down by Vision and left partly paralyzed.
fall: Thaddeus Ross locks Sam, Wanda, Clint and Scott in the Raft, until Steve breaks them out.
Captain America: Civil War
Natasha, who let Steve and Bucky go, is hunted by Ross as a fugitive.
Black Widow
Scott takes a plea deal and spends two years under house arrest.
Ant-Man and the Wasp

item.b: Quill went home to Earth to see his grandpa. Gamora's back with the Ravagers, Drax and Nebula are staying on Knowhere, Mantis went to find herself, and I'm captain now. New roster: me, Groot, Kraglin, Cosmo, Adam and the kid Phyla. Apply in person.

item: Pym Technologies headquarters implodes

item.where: Attilan, on the Moon, and Oahu, Hawaii
item.cause: Maximus breaks his pact with Black Bolt and, when Triton captures him, reveals that the dome protecting Attilan will fail unless he presses his hand to a scanner every hour.
item.out: With the dome too damaged to save, the Royal Family broadcast Maximus's plans to the city and offer the people a way out, and Eldrac carries them to Earth. Black Bolt locks Maximus in the bunker and leaves through Eldrac, who dies with the city as Attilan is destroyed.
loss: Eldrac, who dies with the city.
Evan Declan, thrown into a Terrigenesis chamber by the revived Gorgon.
fall: Medusa leaves Attilan's Terrigen crystals with Louise on Earth, out of Maximus's reach.
Inhumans
On Earth, Black Bolt and Medusa address their people as they begin a new life there.
Inhumans

item.where: Counter-Earth
item.cause: The Guardians land on the High Evolutionary's Counter-Earth, a copy of Earth peopled with his animal Humanimals, hunting for the passkey that can switch off the kill switch inside Rocket. Judging his world a failure, the High Evolutionary lifts his Arête Laboratories complex off the planet and bombards it.
item.out: The bombardment wipes out the planet and every Humanimal on it. Peter Quill and Groot get away with the override code from Recorder Theel's body, while Drax, Nebula and Mantis, who boarded the Arête to rescue them, are left aboard it.
loss: The people of Counter-Earth, all of them killed.
Recorder Theel, killed by Quill after he and Groot leap with him to Counter-Earth.
fall: Quill uses the code to shut off Rocket's kill switch and save his life.
Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3

item.where: Manhattan and Queens, New York
item.cause: Billy Russo escapes the hospital with gaps in his memory and, hidden by his therapist Krista Dumont, gathers veterans from Curtis Hoyle's support group into a masked crew.
item.out: After a check-cashing robbery, the crew goes on a spree of robbery and murder from a Queens warehouse called Valhalla, where Billy murders three women and leaves Frank Castle to take the blame. It ends when Dinah Madani shoots Billy, and Frank finds him wounded and kills him.
loss: Three women, killed by Billy at Valhalla.
Members of Billy's own crew, killed by Billy.
Billy Russo, shot dead by Frank.
fall: Madani throws Krista Dumont out of a window, and Krista survives, badly hurt.
The Punisher S2
Brett Mahoney agrees to a story that leaves Frank out.
The Punisher S2
Frank fully takes up the Punisher's mantle and turns down a job with Madani at the CIA.
The Punisher S2

item: Giant lizard attacks the Williamsburg Bridge
Police Captain George Stacy killed

item.where: Hollywood, Los Angeles, in the reality where Agatha Harkness went to Hollywood
item.cause: Agatha Harkness has drained the powers of every Eternal but Kingo for a ritual to take the power of Tiamut, the Celestial buried in Earth's core. When Kingo sides with her, Arishem comes to destroy the Earth.
item.out: With Howard Stark and Edwin Jarvis's help, Agatha takes Kingo's and Tiamut's power, becomes a Celestial and defeats Arishem. Kingo talks her out of keeping the power, and she frees the Eternals and makes movies with him instead.
fall: At the premiere of Cosmic Queen, Kingo warns that Arishem's defeat has drawn the other Celestials' attention.
What If...?

item.where: Jotunheim
item.cause: On the day of Thor's coronation, Frost Giants sneak into Odin's vault for the Casket of Ancient Winters, breaking the truce that has held since Odin defeated them on Earth in 965 AD. Against his father's orders, Thor leads Loki, Sif and the Warriors Three to Jotunheim for revenge.
item.out: The fight goes badly, and Odin rides in to pull them out, ending the truce with Laufey. Odin strips Thor of his power and casts him and Mjolnir down to Earth.
loss: The Frost Giants who break into the vault, burned by the Destroyer.
The old peace between Asgard and Jotunheim.
fall: Loki learns he is a Frost Giant, Odin falls into the Odinsleep, and Loki takes the throne.
Thor

item.where: The Darkhold's temple, Mount Wundagore
item.t: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
item.cause: Wanda Maximoff brings America Chavez to the Darkhold's temple on Mount Wundagore, where its spells were first carved, to take her power to cross universes.
item.out: Stephen Strange dreamwalks into the corpse of a dead variant of himself to stop her, and America breaks free and sends Wanda to Earth-838, where her sons' fear of her shows her what she has become. Wanda brings the mountain down on herself, destroying every copy of the Darkhold across the multiverse.
loss: Wanda Maximoff, buried as the mountain comes down.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
fall: America Chavez begins training at Kamar-Taj.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Clea tells Strange he has caused an incursion, and he follows her into the Dark Dimension.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

item.where: Ultron's world, in the reality where Ultron won
item.cause: Ultron sets out to conquer the multiverse, and the Watcher breaks his oath to gather heroes from other worlds as the Guardians of the Multiverse.
item.out: Natasha Romanoff and Captain Carter fire Arnim Zola's mind into Ultron, and Zola destroys him from within and takes his body. Killmonger betrays the team to grab the Infinity Stones, and Strange Supreme seals both him and Zola in a pocket dimension that he agrees to guard.
loss: Ultron, destroyed from within by Zola.
Gamora's Infinity Crusher, which fails against Stones from another universe.
fall: The Watcher sends each hero home and brings Natasha to a world whose Avengers candidates were murdered, where she subdues Loki.
What If...?
Captain Carter and her world's Natasha find the Hydra Stomper with someone inside.
What If...?
Freed from Strange Supreme's prison, Killmonger fights in armor powered by the Stones until Kahhori pulls him out and sends him home.
What If...?

item: President Ellis nominates Thaddeus Ross for Secretary of State
Earthquakes shake the world
Giant stone figure rises from the Indian Ocean
